name: Computational Fluid Dynamics
description: Review of governing equations for fluid flow, finite difference methods, numerical stability, finite volume method and its application to steady 1-D, 2-D and 3-D convection-diffusion problems, extension of FVM to unsteady 1-D, 2-D and 3-D convection diffusion problems, pressure-velocity coupling, solution of discretized Navier Stokes equations and boundary conditions, multi-grid methods, differences between laminar and turbulent flows, Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes equations, closure problem; RANS based turbulence models. Introduction to DNS and LES.
